name: tempdir-cleanup-flake
title: Fix flaky TemporaryDirectory teardown in install test support
description: tests/install_test_support.py:129 constructs tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() without ignore_cleanup_errors=True. Tests that clone or run git inside the temp tree can race git's background writes during teardown, so rmtree fails with OSError [Errno 39] Directory not empty. Observed on PR #223 CI: test_update_e2e.UpdateEndToEndTest errored on ubuntu-latest/3.10 after all 739 tests ran, and the identical commit passed on rerun. The failure is in teardown only, never in an assertion, so it reports as a test error while the code under test is fine.
creator: sdelmas
notes: Implemented and merged (PR #225, 026a06b). One acceptance criterion was NOT met as written: the PRD asked for the failure to be staged by holding a file open under the temp tree, which is impossible — an open file does not block unlink on POSIX, and the real failure is a race against git auto-gc in a separate process. Substituted a test that drives tempfile's actual error handler with the exact ENOTEMPTY, proven discriminating by mutation (reverting the fix fails the guard). The original race is therefore not reproduced by any test; confidence rests on the mechanism. See the COMPLETION section in prd.md.
